title: わをん・さいごの おと
jp: わ行 ・ gojuon row 10 (FINALE) ・ the last sounds ・ kids / graduation singalong
eyebrow: Row 10 · わをん · The last sounds
meta: Kids / kodomo no uta · lead + chorus (P3, F-14)
blurb: The finale of the gojuon — わ を ん, the last row — as a joyful graduation singalong. It can't be a normal song: only わ starts words, を is only the object particle (always "o"), and ん never begins a word — it ends them. So this is a "last sounds" celebration: わ-words in sentences, a を beat for the little joiner you've used all series, a ん beat for the sound that finishes words (everybody hums ん…), and a whole-gojuon victory lap — one beloved word from every row, あ→ら, you can read them all now! This is the kids cut — a lead + children's chorus, call-and-response (F-14); the natural way to land the series. The same finale is also rendered Female and Male (Strategy B).
concept: わ行 is the last row, and it is special. Only わ is a word-starter (わに, わし, わた…). を is only the object particle — essentially never begins a word, always read "o" (findings F-16). ん never starts a word either; it only ends syllables and words (ぱん, みかん, きりん). So you can't make 3 groups × 3 words — わ行 needs a different design.

The design: a graduation "last sounds" song. A わ teach (six わ-words, each in a small sentence — same onset blends, so context is essential, F-10), then a を beat that shows the joiner doing its job in already-known sentences (りんご を たべる, うた を うたう), then a ん beat for the finisher (おいしい ぱん, あまい みかん), and a whole-gojuon REVIEW — one word from every earlier row (あさ・かに・さかな・つき・ねこ・ほし・みかん・やぎ・りんご) recombined into a ぜんぶ よめた！ victory lap. The ultimate F-13 payoff.

This is the kids cut — and the natural finale. A bright youthful lead calls, a children's chorus answers, call-and-response (P3, validated F-14). The refrain わ を ん is sung by the whole chorus — the classroom graduating together (F-07). The same finale is also rendered Female (city pop) and Male (koto) — Strategy B in personas.md — so every playlist gets its capstone, but the kids voice is where a "you can read them all now!" singalong belongs. The closing sweep あ か さ た な は ま や ら わ を ん is the whole class in one breath.
